recipes.name: Buttered Noodles inspired by Community
instructions: For the 5 Minute Buttered Noodles
Start by bringing a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add egg noodles and remove from the heat once tender. - 1 box egg noodles - Water

Drain the noodles and rinse with tap water before adding the noodles back to the pot. Add unsalted butter, a pinch of kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. - 2 tbsp unsalted butter - Kosher salt - Freshly ground pepper
Mix until the butter has completely melted and the seasoning has mixed evenly across the noodles.
For the 15 Minute (Better) Buttered Noodles
Start by bringing an oval-shaped dutch oven of slightly salted water to a boil and then add the high-end pasta. **Use slightly less water to make sure the water is extra starchy.
Once the pasta is done, put aside about ½ cup of the water and then drain the pasta. Return it to the warm pot and do not rinse. - 1 box high end supermarket pasta
Add the unsalted gourmet butter, the pasta water, and a generous pinch of kosher salt. - 2 tbsp Gourmet butter - Kosher salt - ¼ cup Pasta water
Give it all a rigorous stir until everything is completely dissolved and mixed together.
For the Homemade Butter
Start by combining heavy cream with cultured buttermilk, whisking to combine then covering to let sit out at room temperature for 24 hours. - 4 cups heavy cream - ½ cup cultured buttermilk

After 24 hours, dump the mixture (which is now creme fraiche) into a stand mixer along with equal parts of room temperature European butter and whip together until all the milk fat separates from the newly minted buttermilk, should only take 15 seconds. - European butter
Once a butter lump is formed, wash it in ice water 4-5 times until the water squeezed out of the butter runs clear. Squeeze out as much water as possible then place it in the fridge.
For the Homemade Pasta

In a large bowl add 80% double zero flour , 20% rye flour, kosher salt, and large eggs. Beat together using a fork and knead for 8-10 minutes. - 12 oz 00 flour - 3 ¼ oz rye flour - 2 tsp kosher salt - 3 large eggs
Place the dough in a Ziploc bag or cover with plastic wrap and let it rest at room temperature for at least 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, cut the dough into smaller pieces then run through a pasta roller 3-4 times. Make sure to fold into thirds after each time through.
Once the desired thinness has been reached, run the thin sheet of pasta through a pasta cutter set for fettuccine style pasta.
On a well-floured rimmed baking sheet, drape the pasta into small nests and give each nest a nice dusting of flour.
For the Homemade Buttered Noodles Cooking

Once ready to cook, place the pasta into a large pot of a small amount of boiling water and let it cook for 90 seconds. During the 90 seconds, make sure to keep a saute pan warm, not hot. - For the Homemade Pasta

After 90 seconds, place the cooked pasta into the warm saute pan along with homemade butter, pasta water, a pinch of kosher salt, and mixing together rigorously. - For the Butter from Scratch - ¼ cup Pasta water - pinch kosher salt
Once the butter sauce has reached an Alfredo-like consistency, place on a plate with a dollop of the creme fraiche, an optional grating of brewers yeast, and enjoy.
